name: @adatechnology/characters-catalog-tool
description: Characters catalog tool: reads the team deliveries (game, Bestiário, Elenco, Retratos, Os Vivos, Arsenal body) and writes the reconciled data of game-characters and game-characters-undead as plain JSON, the golden captures of the characters, and the game slice for the zombiada repository, with a --check that fails when the generated files are stale.
